name: Azure-D3
tagline: Vitamin D3 60,000 IU for Bone Health and Calcium Balance
shortDescription: Azure-D3 is a Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol) supplement formulated to help restore Vitamin D levels and support bone health. It promotes calcium absorption, helps maintain calcium and phosphate balance, and supports bone mineralization and skeletal muscle strength. Available in convenient Soft gel Capsule and Sachet forms, Azure-D3 supports Vitamin D supplementation across various clinical needs.

longDescription.title: Azure-D3 – Vitamin D3 60,000 IU for Bone Health and Calcium Balance
paragraphs: Maintaining adequate Vitamin D levels is essential for healthy bones, proper calcium absorption, and normal muscle function. Azure-D3 by Azure Drugs & Pharma contains Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3) 60,000 IU, formulated to support Vitamin D replenishment and promote overall musculoskeletal health.

Vitamin D3 plays a vital role in regulating calcium and phosphate levels in the body, helping maintain bone mineralization and skeletal strength. It also facilitates calcium absorption and supports the body's ability to maintain healthy calcium balance.
